while.definition: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.

whim.definition: A fanciful impulse, or sudden change of idea.

whims.definition: Form of whim (plural): A fanciful impulse, or sudden change of idea.

whispers.definition: Form of whisper (plural): The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially without vibration of the vocal cords; the sound thus produced.

whistle.definition: To make a shrill, high-pitched sound by forcing air through the mouth. To produce a whistling sound, restrictions to the flow of air are created using the teeth, tongue and lips.

white.definition: Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

whiter.definition: Form of white (comparative): Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

whitest.definition: Form of white (superlative): Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

wholeheartedly.definition: In a wholehearted (“showing enthusiastic and unconditional commitment”) manner; without reserve; enthusiastically, unreservedly.

wholly.definition: Completely and entirely; to the fullest extent.

who’s.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

wicked.definition: Evil or mischievous by nature; morally reprehensible.

wide.definition: Having a large physical extent from side to side.

widespread.definition: Affecting, or found throughout, a large area (e.g. the entire land or body); broad in extent; widely diffused.

widow.definition: A person whose spouse is absent.

widower.definition: A man whose spouse has died (and who has not remarried); a man in relation to his late spouse; masculine of widow.

wield.definition: To handle with skill and ease, especially a weapon or tool.

windows.definition: Form of window (plural): An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

wings.definition: Form of wing (plural): An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

witchcraft.definition: The practice of witches; magic, sorcery, or the use of supernatural powers to influence or predict events.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

witnesses.definition: Form of witness (plural): Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

wizard.definition: Someone, usually male, who uses (or has skill with) magic, mystic items, and magical and mystical practices.

woe.definition: Great sadness or distress; a misfortune causing such sadness.

woke.definition: Form of wake (past): (often followed by up) To stop sleeping.

womb.definition: In female mammals, the organ in which the young are conceived and grow until birth; the uterus.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

wore.definition: Form of wear (past): To have on.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

wounded.definition: Form of wound (participle past): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wrapping.definition: Form of wrap (gerund participle present): To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.
